nodes.label: Identity and API keys contract (M1 SP6)
Rule: an API is done only when its UI screen is wired in the same SP
nodes.source_location: ## Rule: an API is done only when its screen is wired
nodes.rationale: The SP that adds or changes an API must: wire the screen in apps/web/src/features/<area>/ (api.ts TanStack Query hooks, keep screens.tsx layout, no cross-feature imports); replace fixture data and remove or label controls the API does not back; handle every contract error code with a precise toast/inline message; update API_UI_MAP and the PROGRESS_HANDOFF 'UI wiring' notes; rebuild the graph (/graphify docs --update, build_project_map.py). Prevents a visual preview from being mistaken for live backend integration.

nodes.label: Rule: an SP with no HTTP API records "No UI" in its row
nodes.rationale: So the next agent does not look for a screen (e.g. SP7 packages/engine, SP8 transport).

nodes.label: Failed mutations re-read the server; submit disabled while pending
nodes.rationale: Key mutations refetch on settle, settings toggles refetch on error; the UI never shows an unsaved value and a double click cannot send twice.

nodes.label: UI_READY — visual layout implemented with demo data only
nodes.rationale: UI_READY does not mean API, auth, mutation, validation, SSE or business behavior exists; a demo click is never a completed mutation. Branch is visual UI complete for U0–U11, not M3 functionally complete.

nodes.label: Claude's integration boundary (keep shell/screens markup, add feature api.ts hooks)
nodes.rationale: Keep app/shell.tsx, styles.css, shared/ui.tsx and features/*/screens.tsx as the UI source; do not create a second page/shell for a UI_READY route.

nodes.label: Create-combo form — UI-only local draft shape (name, strategy, models, fusion)
nodes.rationale: A draft for discussion, not an agreed API contract; does not persist or dispatch requests.

nodes.label: Provider catalog — 111 visible 9Router IDs (metadata only)
nodes.rationale: Catalog is metadata, not 111 working integrations.

nodes.label: UI error code: NETWORK_ERROR
nodes.raised_by: fetch failed; server down or offline
nodes.ui_behavior: Toast 'Could not reach AIGate…'; queries show error state with Retry

nodes.label: UI error code: BAD_RESPONSE
nodes.raised_by: 2xx with a non-JSON body (e.g. SPA page for a mistyped path)

nodes.label: UI error code: UNAUTHENTICATED (401)
nodes.raised_by: protected route after logout elsewhere, password change, or 24 h expiry
nodes.ui_behavior: Toast 'Your session ended'; shell re-checks status and redirects to /login (not shown on deliberate sign-out)

nodes.label: UI error code: INVALID_CREDENTIALS (401)
nodes.raised_by: wrong password at login or password change
nodes.ui_behavior: Inline warning and toast with attempts left before lockout

nodes.label: UI error code: RATE_LIMITED (429)
nodes.ui_behavior: Toast 'Try again in Ns' from retryAfter

nodes.label: UI error code: NOT_LOCAL (403)
nodes.raised_by: first-password setup from a non-local client
nodes.ui_behavior: Tells the user to use the host machine or AIGATE_INITIAL_PASSWORD

nodes.label: UI error code: NOT_FOUND (404)
nodes.raised_by: a key deleted in another tab

nodes.label: UI error code: INVALID_REQUEST (400)
nodes.ui_behavior: Server message shown as-is because it names the field

nodes.label: UI error code: HTTP_5xx
nodes.raised_by: unexpected server error or proxy page
nodes.ui_behavior: Toast with HTTP status and 'check the server log'

nodes.label: UI error code: any other code (fallback)
Who counts as local (loopback socket + loopback Host + Origin)
nodes.rationale: Host and Origin checks stop DNS rebinding, where a malicious page resolves its domain to 127.0.0.1.

nodes.label: Deny-by-default /api/* access (only status/login/logout/setup are public)
nodes.rationale: Any new controller is protected unless marked public; otherwise 401 UNAUTHENTICATED.

nodes.label: DashboardAuthGuard (global APP_GUARD, @Public())
nodes.rationale: Replaced the SP5 loopback-only hook.

nodes.label: Login lockout: 5 failures → 30 s / 2 min / 10 min / 30 min, capped at 10,000 clients
nodes.rationale: Client key is the socket address; forwarded headers not trusted. 9router's unbounded map is an IMPLEMENTATION_ACCIDENT.

nodes.label: DB-stored sessions (aigate_session cookie, SHA-256 token hash, 24 h, max 20)
nodes.rationale: Replaces 9router's JWT so logout and password changes revoke sessions at once.

nodes.label: API key format: aigate_ + 32 random bytes base64url; SHA-256 + last 4 stored
nodes.rationale: Replaces sk-{machineId}-{keyId}-{crc8} with a hardcoded CRC secret; plaintext is never stored, list returns masked key only.

nodes.label: AIGATE_RESET_PASSWORD=true (boot-time recovery, no HTTP reset route)
nodes.rationale: A loopback address alone does not prove the owner on a shared machine, and the CLI token does not exist yet.

nodes.label: scrypt password hashing (node:crypto, N = 2^15, constant-time compare)
ApiKeysRepository.isValid (unique-index lookup by hash, active only)

Decision (user, 2026-09-25, option A): on shared machines rely on AIGATE_INITIAL_PASSWORD
nodes.rationale: Another OS user can win the first-setup race on shared loopback; a one-time setup code (0600 file + boot link) was deferred until apps/cli or server deployments need it.

nodes.label: Decision (user, 2026-09-25): onboarding is one step (set password, open dashboard)
nodes.rationale: Stitch Connect/Verify steps removed: a provider is not required at first run; providers are connected later from Providers screens. Diverges from spec §10.9 #20 five-step onboarding.

nodes.label: Decision (user, 2026-09-25): route all four SQLite clients through one locked sqlite-proxy wrapper
nodes.rationale: SPIKE-1: without a lock sqlite-proxy loses data under concurrent async transactions.

nodes.rationale: 9router scans only the trailing user turn although everything is sent upstream; labeled SUSPECTED_BUG in the contract.

nodes.label: Allowlist PATCH — unknown, secret or wrongly typed keys → 400, nothing changed
nodes.rationale: Keeps the CWE-915 mass-assignment intent; replaces 9router's name blocklist that silently dropped two names and stored everything else.

nodes.label: Write-through in-process settings cache
nodes.rationale: A PATCH takes effect on the next request; this process is the only writer.

nodes.label: Typed single-row settings table (CHECK id = 1, column defaults)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the untyped JSON blob where a renamed key silently lost the user's value; secrets are not settings.
